scope: Autonomous roadmap stages 1-2: independent loads/budget audit, longer unmodified baseline, controlled bulk and boundary diagnostics; no high-Re input bypass
baseline: Installed aerokinetic 0.5.0 wheel, lbmpy/pystencils 1.4; GitHub baseline fb09924b4579c4ea646aba77b87edb2449a54c9b
invariants: Preserve original Re=30000, alpha=4, finite-TE NACA0012, c=0.15m, moment=c/4, lattice_speed=0.04, perturbation=0.0001 seed31 for the continued baseline
Never overwrite existing runs or fabricate experimental coefficients
No experimental validation claim from a balance test, checkpoint or CPU run

first_checks.wall_loads: Compare production boundary-index momentum exchange against independently enumerated fluid-solid adjacency, including owned periodic span
first_checks.open_budget: Compute owned-fluid PDF mass, linear momentum, angular momentum before/after a single update and independent external/wall fluxes; expose any boundary edits to owned fluid
first_checks.tolerance: Raw loads absolute 2e-10; mass/momentum residual per owned-fluid cell 2e-12; angular residual additionally scaled by chord cells 2e-12
first_checks.geometry: NACA0012 alpha0/4, mirror and independent shift of reference point, fixed geometry and no perturbation for exact symmetry checks

long_baseline.purpose: Measure transient/drift over windows [3,6], [6,12], [12,18], [18,24]; not a mesh convergence study

numeric_changes: Only after a defect or numerical parameter inconsistency is independently demonstrated; tests and installed-wheel comparison required
independent_next_work: Safe continuation into a NEW output directory, diagnostics/reports, resource profiling and controlled relaxation interface; do not silently turn a future feature into a validated solver
validation: inconclusive until numerical/statistical convergence and tunnel conditions are established
